title: Sensor Calibration Index
source: 108. Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
brief: A low-power sensor stores its calibration keys as a sorted list, but lookups need to be done with a small in-memory tree whose search path never gets long. We want to turn the sorted keys into such a tree once at boot.

Implement buildBalancedIndex(nums), where nums holds the keys in increasing order, and return the root TreeNode of a binary search tree that contains every key, balanced so that at every node the heights of the left and right subtrees differ by at most one.
